# Application Insights Query

Query Azure Application Insights for logs, errors, and telemetry.

## When To Use

- Querying application logs and traces
- Investigating production errors
- Analyzing telemetry and performance data
- Writing KQL queries for Application Insights

## Common Queries

- Error rates and exception details
- Request performance and latency
- Dependency call failures
- Custom event analysis
